admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent (e.g., IB, IGCSE/GCE, SAT) with equivalency from Jordanian Ministry of Education
admission_requirements.exam_details: Placement tests in English, German, and computer for all admitted students; acceptance exam (portfolio and interview) required for Architecture and Design and Visual Communication; admission exam available for students with Tawjihi 65-74.99% in certain majors (Nursing, Computer Science, Management Sciences, Logistics, International Accounting, Business Intelligence, Design and Visual Communication)
admission_requirements.english_requirement: English proficiency placement test upon admission; TOEFL or IELTS accepted for certain programs (minimum TOEFL 500 for postgraduate)

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: 3,354 - 4,634 JOD per year (including semester fees) for regular Jordanian program; international students 130-150 JOD per credit hour
tuition_fees.notes: Credit hour fees (regular): humanities 70 JOD, engineering/IT 100 JOD, architecture/business/nursing 110 JOD; international program: 130-150 JOD/credit hour; mandatory German year costs approximately 8,000-10,000 JOD for study and living in Germany; additional semester fees (registration, computer, medical insurance) ~557 JOD per semester. Detailed fee PDFs available at gju.edu.jo/content/tuition-fees-8319

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: MOHE (Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research), 13 German accredited programs, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 21001:2018, DAAD
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS World University Rankings 2026: 801-850; QS World University Rankings 2027: 781-790; THE World University Rankings 2026: 801-1000; QS Arab Region Rankings 2025: 44th (per GJU homepage); GJU homepage lists 801-1000 World University Ranking

high_demand_majors: Engineering (Mechatronics, Industrial, Electrical, Mechanical and Maintenance Engineering)
market_demand.notes: GJU reports 92% employability rate; strong employer reputation ranking in top 554 globally per QS 2025; 102+ dual studies industry partners providing practical training; German-style applied education with mandatory German year enhances graduate competitiveness

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No on-campus dormitories; Deanship of Student Affairs assists students in finding off-campus housing in Amman; private flats available near Madaba campus and in Amman
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: DAAD German Year scholarships (992 Euro/month + 850 Euro travel allowance), Erasmus+ International Credit Mobility, research assistant scholarships for master's students, student fund for financial aid and academic excellence awards, GJU Future Minds Fellowship

contact_info.address: Amman Madaba Street, P.O. Box 35247, Amman 11180, Jordan
